source: Artifactory Xray vulnerability feed mirror, curated by GIS for the CSWT estate
note: Offline snapshot. The real Xray instance consults the vendor feed and the NVD; this file carries the advisories that actually matter to the Meridian dependency tree so that a scan is deterministic and works on a build agent with no egress. Ranges use plain comparison operators, one range per entry. XRAY-* identifiers are the bank's internal tracking ids; the CVE column is the upstream reference.
